funding.name: WV PROMISE Scholarship
funding.provider: West Virginia Higher Education Policy Commission / College Foundation of WV
funding.provides: Merit-based award for West Virginia high school graduates attending public or independent two- or four-year institutions.
funding.eligibility: Graduating high school with a 3.0 GPA or better and meeting academic requirements (per page).
funding.amount: Up to $5,500 per year or the cost of tuition and mandatory fees, whichever is less (per page)
funding.how_to_apply: Complete the Promise application and FAFSA by March 1, 2027 for the class of 2027 (per page).

funding.name: West Virginia Higher Education Grant (HEGP)
funding.provider: West Virginia Higher Education Policy Commission
funding.provides: Need-based annual grant of $3,400 for West Virginia students (page is the Feb 2025 release for the 2025-26 cycle).

funding.name: WorkForce WV Eligible Training Provider search (WIOA)

funding.how_to_apply: Search the ETP database or ask your local American Job Center (per page).
